stages.name: Heavy band
stages.work: Band-assisted Nordics, heavy band, 4 s lowering

exercises.name: Band-assisted Nordic curl
exercises.cue: Band anchored overhead. Hips stay extended: no hinging at the waist.
exercises.note: Not while the hamstring is red.

exercises.name: Hip bridge hold
exercises.cue: Heels under your knees, squeeze glutes and hamstrings, hips up in one straight line.

exercises.name: Band-assisted Nordic curl
exercises.cue: Straight line from knees to head. Make the lowering last a full count of four.
exercises.note: Move to the light band only once you finish all three sets of 6 cleanly with the medium one. Not while the hamstring is red.

stages.name: Unassisted eccentric
stages.work: No band; 5 s lowering; hands catch at the floor and push back

exercises.name: Hip bridge hold
exercises.cue: Heels under your knees, squeeze glutes and hamstrings, hips up in one straight line.

exercises.name: Nordic curl, slow lowering
exercises.cue: Lower as slowly as you can with a straight body, catch yourself with both hands, then push back up.
exercises.note: If you are falling faster than about 3 seconds, end the set. A sore back of the thigh for a day or two is normal; sharp pain is not, so stop. Not while the hamstring is red.

stages.name: Push-back reduction
stages.work: As N3 with the push-back reduced to fingertips

exercises.name: Hip bridge hold
exercises.cue: Heels under your knees, squeeze glutes and hamstrings, hips up in one straight line.

exercises.name: Nordic curl, fingertip push
exercises.cue: Catch yourself with both hands, then push back with your fingertips only so your hamstrings do the work.
exercises.note: Push a little lighter each week. If the lowering gets faster than about 3 seconds, end the set. Not while the hamstring is red.

exercises.name: Hip bridge hold
exercises.cue: Heels under your knees, squeeze glutes and hamstrings, hips up in one straight line.

exercises.name: Full Nordic curl, no hands
exercises.tempo: 5 s down, then pull back up
exercises.cue: Lower slowly, then pull yourself back up with your hamstrings, hands off the floor.
exercises.note: If you cannot pull back up, catch with your hands and use a fingertip push. That rep does not count. Not while the hamstring is red.

exercises.name: Test set: strict Nordic curls
exercises.tempo: 5 s down, then pull back up
exercises.cue: Straight body, no hands, slow down and smooth up. Stop at the first rep that is not clean.
exercises.note: Once a week at most, in your freshest session. Five clean reps is the standard for this stage. Not while the hamstring is red.

stages.name: Weighted
stages.work: Weighted, +2.5 → +5 kg at the chest (the old feat)

exercises.name: Hip bridge hold
exercises.cue: Heels under your knees, squeeze glutes and hamstrings, hips up in one straight line.

exercises.name: Weighted Nordic curl
exercises.tempo: 4 s down, then pull back up

load.text: +2.5 kg at the chest, working up to +5 kg

exercises.cue: Hold the weight against your chest, keep a straight body, lower slowly and pull back up with no hands.
exercises.note: Add weight only once all three sets of 3 are clean. A weighted vest is safer than a plate, because your hands stay free to catch you. Stop at any sharp hamstring pain. Not while the hamstring is red.
